name: Box
description: Generic container with token-based styling props. Foundation of every other component's layout. Maps props directly to CSS custom properties.

padding.description: Spacing token name for all sides padding (e.g. 'spacing-component-md')

margin.description: Spacing token name for all sides margin

border.description: Color token name for border color

children.description: Content to render inside the box

do: Use Box as the base container for layout composition
Pass semantic token names as prop values
Use paddingX/paddingY for directional padding (maps to CSS logical properties)
doNot: Do not pass raw CSS values — only token names
Do not use Box for visual components — use specific components instead
Do not nest Boxes deeply when Stack or Inline would be clearer

accessibility.notes: Box is a layout utility with no inherent semantics. Use the 'as' prop to render semantic elements where appropriate.
